_comment: One-way ceiling on oversized source files, per package. The number is Σ max(0, lines − 500) — the total lines past the limit, NOT a file count, so splitting a large file always lowers it and never trips the gate. check-file-size-ratchet.ts fails when a package's number RISES. After splitting something, run `pnpm lint:file-size --update` to lock the win; --update never raises a floor. Raising a number requires editing this file in the same PR.
_apps_api_src_note: 44022 → 44026 (+4) for the null-handling that extractJsonFromLlm's honest contract forces on its callers. The util used to fabricate `{ [fallbackKey]: response } as T` on total parse failure; removing that makes the return `T | null`, and eight files now say `?? {}` or widen a type to optional. All four lines land in files already past 500. Splitting a service so a `?? {}` fits is the ratchet driving the design; the file actually worth splitting here is application-analysis-workflow.service.ts at 3856 lines, and doing that takes this number back down.
_apps_api_src_note_2026_08_04: 44026 → 44054 (+28). Comments, not code: the four security notes this branch adds (admin-review's PUBLIC default, case-tools' straggler cast, swipe's oracle + role rule, the admin dialog's retired option) all land in files already past 500 lines. Splitting a service so an explanation fits is the ratchet driving the design — and these explanations are the deliverable: each one records a defect that was invisible precisely because nobody had written it down. swipe.service.ts is the one that grew most (568 lines) and is the nearest thing here worth splitting.
_apps_api_prisma_note_match_pools: 12105 → 12110 (+5). Five comment lines on `seedMatchPools` in seed-teams.ts (2,512 lines), recording the one property that lets prisma/seed-match-pools.ts run that function against production while the rest of its file — mock users, mock teams, `teamMembership.deleteMany` — must never run there. The new entry point itself is 63 lines and contributes nothing to this number. The reason the note lives on the callee rather than only on the caller: the next person to add a `deleteMany` to seedMatchPools will be reading seed-teams.ts, not the prod seed, and that edit would silently make a prod-safe seed destructive. Splitting a 2,500-line demo seed so five lines of safety rationale fit is the ratchet driving the design.
_apps_api_prisma_note: 11953 → 12105 (+152) for the 2026-08-04 batch in seed-testing-policy-2026-07-25.ts (the file lands at 656 lines; 128 of the 152 are the rows and header as written, the other 24 are prettier re-wrapping the long evidence strings on commit — set this number AFTER lint-staged has run, not before, or the commit fails its own gate): ten verified REQUIRED rows for schools at or above 20% admit (the Florida State University System, UGA + Georgia State, UT Austin, UT Knoxville, Auburn), plus the header section recording which candidates were rejected and why. Earlier, 11948 → 11953 (+5) for the Penn row on the same file. A split was measured rather than assumed: moving the table into a sibling .data.ts leaves it at ~565 lines, because the provenance essay has to travel with the data it explains, so the overage drops from 132 to 65 and still does not clear the limit. Splitting by collection batch would clear it and is the wrong shape — 'which file is UF in?' is the drift this table exists to close. This file's length is proportional to how much of the world has been verified, which is the deliverable. The oversized file here is seed-all-features.ts (3458 lines); that is the one worth splitting, and doing so takes this number back down.
_apps_web_src_note_2026_08_04: 16319 → 16321 (+2) for the comment marking PUBLIC as retired in create-case-dialog.tsx (549 lines). Two lines behind a file split would be the ratchet driving the design.
_apps_api_src_note_2026_08_04_any: 44054 → 44094 (+40), measured on top of #549 rather than against the main this branch started from — where the same change read +27. The delta is not additive across branches, so the number has to be re-measured after every rebase; merging the two sides of the conflict would have produced a figure that matches neither tree. Comments and the restored feature, not new complexity: prediction-transformer LOST lines while dropping 80 `any`, and school-tools lost 2. The growth is recommendation.service.ts — the case-comparison path wired to SchoolListItem, the international flag wired to detectInternationalStatus, and the notes recording that neither had ever run. The ratchet counts lines, so a three-line explanation of a dead feature costs the same as three lines of new branching; that is a documented limit of the metric, not a reason to omit it.
_apps_web_src_note: 16321 → 16082 (−239), measured after rebasing onto a main that already carries #549's +2. +2 of the movement is `placeholderData: keepPreviousData` landing in three files already past 500 lines; −241 is extracting the types, label maps and pure helpers out of resume/[id]/page.tsx into ./_lib/resume-editor.ts. That page was 2,941 lines — six times the limit its own `page-size-limit` rule sets, and the largest file in apps/web. It is still 2,698, so the remaining split (WorkbenchSidebar / TargetContextPanel / AiAssistantPanel, below the page component) is the next one worth doing.
_apps_api_src_note_redis_cron: 44094 → 44142 (+48). redis.service.ts (2,090 lines) gains `tryAcquireLock` and the note explaining why it has to exist: `setNXStrict` returned false both when another holder had the key and when the command timed out, so every caller logging "skipped" reported a Redis outage as normal contention. Prod ran a month that way — circuit breaker opening 60-85×/day, every locked @Cron silently skipping inside those 30s windows, AccountPurgeService never once completing a run. The rest is the keepAlive comment. Splitting a 2,090-line service to fit the explanation of a month-long silent outage would be the ratchet driving the design.
_apps_web_src_note_community_names: 16147 → 16149 (+2). One `useCommunityName()` line each in post-list.tsx and create-post-dialog.tsx, both already past 500. The hook itself and its test are new files well under the limit, so they score zero — this number only ever counts lines added to files that are already oversized. Splitting a forum component so two hook calls fit is the ratchet driving the design.
_apps_api_src_note_case_tags: 44142 → 44145 (+3). essay-gallery.service.ts gains the stripInternalTags import and its two-line reason. The importer's dedup key `source:<url>#<author>` was reaching readers from BOTH unauthenticated surfaces — measured 2026-08-05, 20/20 rows on GET /cases and 10/10 on GET /essay-ai/gallery — rendering as a 551px URL badge inside a 386px card. It cannot be deleted from the data (it is the re-import idempotency key), so it is stripped at the serve boundary.
_apps_web_src_note_whatif_prefill: 16082 → 16136 (+54). prediction/page.tsx: the estimate list no longer pre-fills on every visit (users were deleting the whole school list row by row), plus the ?autorun=1 carve-out that keeps the dashboard and onboarding entry points working — that coupling breaks SILENTLY, so it is written down rather than left to be rediscovered. Also replaces a stale COL1 comment that claimed the column can never overflow; it was written when COL1 held one card and now holds two.
_apps_api_src_note_suggestions_depth: 44145 → 44179 (+34). prediction.service.ts gains two suggestion branches so the 46-entry MAJOR_CATEGORY_PROGRAMS catalogue can surface as advice of its own. A reach school produced exactly two suggestions (essay + early round) while `competitionNames` was never referenced on that path and `summerNames` survived only as a trailing clause inside someone else's bullet. Net POSITIVE despite also deleting cron-heartbeat.util.ts here — that file was under 500 lines so it contributed nothing to this overage, while these lines land in a file already past it.
_apps_web_src_note_tour_anchors: 16136 → 16147 (+11). header.tsx (already past 500) gains the data-tour anchors the welcome tour points at, plus the comment explaining why Cases/AI anchor on the menu OPENER rather than on items inside a closed dropdown. Five of that tour's steps had been targeting selectors nothing rendered — driver.js highlights empty space instead of erroring, so every new user got a broken tour and nothing said so.
_apps_api_src_note_application_year: 44179 → 44223 (+44). outcome.service.ts and prediction-persistence.service.ts gain the reasoning for pairing a prediction to its OWN season: SchoolDeadline accumulates a row per school per season, so a bare `decisionDate <= now` let a school's closed 2024 round tell a 2027 applicant to report a result for an application they never made. Also records why applicationYear is stamped at WRITE time (re-deriving on read would relabel every historical row each August) and why a null season is withheld rather than matched. Includes two `governance: system-scope` annotations: the isolation rule reads the ENCLOSING METHOD for a `userId`, but its brace matcher counts braces inside strings and generic return types, so `Promise<{...}>` ends the method at line 267 and both queries fall into a 20-line fallback window that cannot see the `userId` parameter. The queries are genuinely system-scope (SchoolDeadline and School have no User relation); the rule's brace matcher was the actual defect, fixed 2026-08-06.
_apps_api_src_note_isolation_matcher: 44223 → 44228 (+5). resume.service.ts gains the `governance: parent-scoped` annotation that applySectionContentUpdates always needed. It was never flagged because the isolation rule's brace matcher ended that method at its own signature — the `Array<{…}>` parameter type balances to zero — so the query fell into a ±20-line fallback that reached into the NEXT method and read ITS `userId`. The same defect false-POSITIVED on outcome.service.ts. Both directions are now seeded in check-integration.proof.ts, which the rule had no proof of at all until now.
_apps_api_src_note_closure_ring_2026_08_: 44157 → 44462 (+305). Closure ring WP1–WP3: StorageService real blob delete + owned-key extract, UserService hardDelete orphan deleteMany + password reauth, outcome pending-decisions distinct-by-school, timeline sort by registrationDeadline, team recruitment ended-edition sink. All land in files already past 500 (user.service, storage.service, outcome.service, timeline-application.service, team-recruitment.service). Splitting application-analysis-workflow.service.ts (3846) is the split that actually moves this number; extracting purge helpers into a sibling under 500 would also drop it. Raised in the same PR as the capability. Set to 44462, not the 44454 first written here: that figure was measured before the last edit to the tree, and this ratchet's number is a measurement of the CURRENT tree, never a running total. Re-measure after every rebase and after lint-staged has run — a stale figure fails the gate on the very branch that raised it, which is how this one arrived unpushable.
_apps_api_src_note_agent_harness_2026_08: 44462 → 45833 (+1371). The durable Agent Harness adds bounded replanning and tool-call accounting to the existing workflow/orchestrator, centralized tool policy metadata, and a new AgentRun service for approval leases, checkpoints, ownership, expiry, and exactly-once recovery. This is production request-path behavior covered by the new approval, policy, workflow, provider, ownership, and recovery tests; moving it immediately before release would create a larger unverified refactor than the measured debt. The first follow-up split should separate checkpoint persistence/lease transitions from agent-run.service.ts and move harness execution state out of workflow-engine.service.ts and orchestrator.service.ts. The 500-line rule and all other targets remain unchanged.
_apps_web_src_note_agent_approvals_2026_: 16089 → 16293 (+204). The existing oversized Agent chat component and hook gain the user-visible approval pause/resume lifecycle, run identifiers, and SSE reconciliation needed to close high-risk actions safely. The behavior shares the existing chat state rather than introducing a second frontend Agent system. A follow-up should extract the approval card and run-event reducer into focused files under 500 lines.
_apps_mobile_src_note_agent_approvals_20: 2600 → 2793 (+193). The existing mobile Agent surfaces gain the same approval/run state model as Web, including ownership-bound approve, reject, cancel, and resume handling. A follow-up should extract the approval controls and run-state presentation from ai.tsx and uncommon-app.tsx; doing that in the release fix would add avoidable cross-platform regression risk.
_apps_api_src_note_agent_output_safety_2: 45758 → 45722 (−36). Output moderation, fail-closed fallback, durable evidence and alert delivery moved from the already oversized orchestrator.service.ts into assistant-output-safety.service.ts. The request path keeps one mandatory safety dependency while the security behavior now has focused tests in a file below the 500-line limit.
